method.purpose: Reproduce timing/coverage observations without changing saved trials or scores
method.prefix_matching: Exact Ethernet captured-header prefix with a length-indexed RX mapping; only one-candidate matches contribute delays, bins and coverage
method.quantiles: Sorted values at min(n-1,floor(n*p)); no interpolation
method.delay_population: All decoded raw samples, including samples read after fixed measurement end; used-sample results separately restrict raw receive time to measurement interval
method.missing_coverage: Unmatched RX occurrences/distinct frames using unambiguous raw prefix matches; coverage is inconclusive when ambiguous_samples is nonzero
method.limitations: RX pcap timestamps have capture precision and small negative delay jitter can occur. This diagnoses observation distortion; it does not prove the exact cause of each model error.
method.prohibition: Independent RX timestamps and labels are diagnostic only. Never deploy them as telemetry timestamps, reconstruct deployable features from the oracle, or use these results to exclude low scores.

exporter_clock_diagnosis.interpretation: Variation after exporter uptime stamping, including uptime quantization; does not isolate kernel queue versus loopback scheduling or infer packet event time.
